```artifact
Feature: High Availability and Data Backup

  Scenario: Availability should be high - 99.999% with a defined outage window of 10 mts every 2nd Sunday
    Given the system is running normally
    When the outage window is triggered every 2nd Sunday
    Then the system is available for 99.999% of the time

  Scenario: The system data shall be backed up every night (full back-up) with a cycle of 30 days
    Given the system is running normally
    When the backup cycle is triggered every night
    Then the system data is backed up every 30 days

  Scenario: Provision to rollback by a month
    Given the system is running normally
    When the rollback option is selected for a month
    Then the system data is restored to the previous month's state

  Scenario: Post back-up everyday the back-up shall be restored on a dummy production system to ensure completeness and correctness of back-up
    Given the system is running normally
    When the backup is restored on a dummy production system every day
    Then the backup is complete and correct

  Scenario: Post that the dummy production database shall be purged
    Given the system is running normally
    When the dummy production database is purged after backup
    Then the database is empty

  Scenario: Since the data is confidential, it will be maintained in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    Given the system is running normally
    When the data is stored in a fireproof cabinet in Mangalore HQ
    Then the data is secure

  Scenario: The system shall be designed to comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
    Given the system is running normally
    When the system is designed to comply with health care regulations
    Then the system is compliant
```
